summary.one_liner: A portable agent skill that audits and rewrites prose to remove "AI-isms," backed by a deterministic zero-dependency detector engine.
summary.what_it_does: The skill runs in rewrite, detect, or edit-in-place modes. Rewrite mode flags AI writing patterns, applies up to two editing passes, and returns one final version. Detect mode lists flags grouped by severity (P0/P1/P2) and separates real problems from judgment calls without changing the text. Edit mode makes minimal targeted changes to a prose file and refuses source code, configuration, and generated data. It uses a tiered word-replacement table (112 entries across three tiers plus 10 Tier 3 phrases) and a catalog of 74 pattern categories described in references/patterns.md. Optional voice profiles (casual, professional, technical, warm, blunt) and content-type profiles shape the output. A bundled Node detector computes a 0–100 score, and CLI, GitHub Action, pre-commit hook, and MCP server wrappers expose it.
use_cases: Removing chatbot-style phrasing from a blog post or draft
Auditing a document for AI tells without altering it
Editing a prose file in place with minimal changes
Gating markdown docs for AI-sounding prose in CI or pre-commit
Replacing buzzwords like 'leverage' or 'robust' with plainer wording
Cleaning up AI-written issue or PR replies
notable: Deterministic zero-dependency detector engine that produces the single numeric score
Three-tier word vocabulary, with frequency markers weighted separately from clarity edits
Two-pass rewrite with a shared editing limit and a preservation validator for code, URLs, tables, and headings
Packaged for many agents: Claude Code, Cowork plugin, OpenClaw, Cursor, Hermes, Codex, ChatGPT, and others
Gate CLI and GitHub Action that fail on finding count per file rather than the composite score
caveats: Rules and detector are calibrated for English only; other languages come from community adaptations
Some pattern categories are judgment calls that a regex cannot decide, so detect mode may flag intentional writing
Single-file dist version (about 138 KB) exceeds the instruction limits of some tools, such as Windsurf rule files and Custom GPT Instructions
